text:
Tara: quick heads-up, console rollout shows green but we're seeing 429s from a small tenant cohort. digging: X-Client-Version header is often missing or still v1.
Kevin: any obvious proxy rewrite?
Tara: looks inconsistent; some proxies strip it, some rewrite.
Sylvia: do we have handshake metrics surfaced?
Dave: we have a sampled counter but not in the rollout dashboard.
Tara: proposal: emit a low-sample (0.5%) pulse per-tenant counting header_present/header_absent/header_mismatch. no request bodies.
Kevin: runtime change: if header missing, prefer v1 for a short TTL (60s) and probe v2 at a configurable probe_rate. avoids immediate quota storms.
Tara: probe sketch: if header_missing then if recently_fallbacked -> v1 else random() < probe_rate -> v2 else v1.
Sylvia: i'll add a console badge for tenants with >1% mismatch over 1h and a heatmap widget + tenant table linking traces.
Dave: edge shim: we can optionally infer header from UA fingerprint and re-inject (opt-in per-tenant). mark inferred in telemetry and exclude from gating early.
Morgan: deploy-bot: rollout telemetry schema update queued to staging in 10m.
Tara: runbook addendum: if after 24h any active cohort shows >0.5% mismatch, pause rollout and revert soft-quota to 100% v1 for affected tenants.
Kevin: timeline checked: telemetry live today, dashboard in ~48h, runtime probe/shim in ~72h.
Tara: thanks — will follow up with smoke results in #eng-platform.
